what: one woof go forecast timed end to end, to anchor the runtime estimator's A6000 rate above the 100,000-column launch bound

configuration.grid: 450 x 360 x 49, dx 3 km, one domain
configuration.physics: Morrison (mp 10), RTE+RRTMGP longwave and shortwave every 12 min, YSU, MM5 surface layer (91), Noah, no cumulus

contention.method: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used and --query-compute-apps every 15 s, /proc/loadavg beside it (45 samples)
contention.card: this forecast was the only compute process on the card in every sample during the forecast
contention.host: load average 5 to 20 from other users' CPU work

prediction_before_this_anchor.command: woof estimate rt-mnl-3km.toml (runner detected: the A6000)
prediction_before_this_anchor.basis: the A6000's 18,000-column anchors (Manila 12 km, Maui 3 km in docs/ADAPTIVE-TIMESTEP.md), carried across the 100,000-column line
prediction_before_this_anchor.verdict: the total missed low: 675 s measured against 861-1905 s predicted. The per-column rate of an 18,000-column domain overstates a 162,000-column one by 1.3-2.6x (the card is not loaded below the launch bound). Prepare, output and restart writes fell inside their brackets.
